mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workspace_members (workspace_id, user_id) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{userId}) ON CONFLICT (workspace_id, user_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS userId, u.name AS name, u.email AS email, wm.created_at AS createdAt FROM workspace_members wm JOIN users u ON u.id = wm.user_id WHERE wm.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} ORDER BY wm.created_at
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM workspace_members WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT workspace_id FROM workspace_members WHERE user_id = #{userId}
